name: g60_sub_drain
purpose: Substitute and a drain move (decision 0032): Gengar (M) of side 2 is damaged by Garchomp's Dragon Claw and by Rough Skin, then its Drain Punch hits the Substitute of Kingambit (M): the Substitute takes the hit and the drain heals the user by ceil(dealt / 2) of the damage the Substitute took (data/moves.ts:18363, Math.ceil), not by the target's HP.
